landing.title: Where licensed businesses change hands
landing.subtitle: Sellers list regulated assets. Buyers publish an acquisition mandate. The platform matches the two and keeps the conversation in one place.
landing.demoTitle: Sign in as a demo user
landing.demoSubtitle: One click, no password to type. Each account is seeded with data so every flow works immediately.
landing.roleSellerBlurb: Publish and manage listings, search buyer mandates, start a conversation.
landing.roleBuyerBlurb: Describe what you are looking for, filter the catalogue, contact a seller.
landing.roleManagerBlurb: Review participants and listings, suspend or remove with a reason, read the audit log.

auth.signInSubtitle: Use a demo account from the home page, or your own credentials.
auth.suspended: This account is suspended and cannot sign in.
auth.needAccount: No account? Every demo account is listed on the home page.

buyer.signedOutTitle: Buyer mandates are for signed-in participants
buyer.signedOutBody: Who is buying what, and with what budget, is not public. Sign in as a seller to browse mandates, or use a demo account from the home page.
buyer.yourMandateHint: Sellers see exactly what is on this page, subject to your visibility setting.

empty.noAssetsHint: Try widening the price range or clearing a facet.
empty.noBuyers: No buyer mandates match these filters
empty.noBuyersHint: Buyers can hide their profile, so some are not listed here.

catalogue.buyersSubtitle: What buyers on the platform are looking for, in their own words.
catalogue.buyersSearch: Search buyers by company, thesis or jurisdiction…

facet.ticketHint: Shows mandates whose range overlaps yours.

ai.hint: Describe what you want in a sentence — e.g. "EMI in Lithuania under 2M with IBAN" — and press Enter.
ai.byModel: Filters set from your sentence by the language model.

detail.yourListingHint: Edit it, change its status or take it off the market from your dashboard.
detail.moderationHint: You are signed in as a platform manager.
detail.notLive: This listing is not public. Current status: {status}.
detail.goneTitle: This listing is no longer available
detail.goneBody: The seller behind it was removed from the platform, so the listing was withdrawn with them. It is kept here for reference rather than deleted.

contact.hint: Messages stay on the platform. The other side sees your name and company.
contact.placeholder: Introduce yourself and say what you would like to know.
contact.signInToContact: Sign in as a buyer to start a conversation.
contact.managersDoNotTrade: Platform managers moderate the marketplace; they do not take part in deals.
contact.wrongSide: Conversations run between a buyer and a seller.
contact.reopened: Added to your existing conversation about this listing.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.subtitle: Every conversation you are part of, newest first.
inbox.cannotReply: The other participant is suspended or removed, so this conversation is read-only. The history is kept.

listingForm.newSubtitle: Publish a regulated business or licence. You can save it as a draft first.
listingForm.editSubtitle: Changes go live immediately for a published listing.
listingForm.title: Listing title
listingForm.titlePlaceholder: EMI licence in Lithuania with live IBAN issuing
listingForm.descriptionHint: What the buyer inherits, why it is being sold, what is already in production.
listingForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the entity, its permissions, the state of operations and what transfers with it.
listingForm.askingPriceHint: Whole units. 2 500 000 and 2.5M are both accepted.
listingForm.benefitsHint: Tick everything that transfers with the entity.
listingForm.reviewHint: Checks the draft for contradictions and for what a buyer will ask about.
listingForm.reviewClean: Nothing to flag — the draft reads as complete.
listingForm.reviewByAi: Rule checks plus suggestions from the language model.
listingForm.reviewByRules: Rule checks only — no AI key configured, or the model did not answer.
listingForm.suspendedTitle: This listing is suspended by a platform manager
listingForm.suspendedHint: It cannot be edited while suspended. Contact the platform to have it reviewed.

dashboard.managerSubtitle: Participants and listings across the whole platform.
dashboard.suspendedNotice: {count, plural, one {# listing is suspended by a platform manager} other {# listings are suspended by a platform manager}}. The reason is shown on each one.
dashboard.noListingsHint: Publish your first regulated asset — you can save it as a draft and finish later.
dashboard.matchingBuyersHint: Scored on category, jurisdiction, licence type and ticket size. The score is computed, not generated.
dashboard.noMandate: You have not described what you are looking for
dashboard.noMandateHint: A mandate is what sellers search. Without one you are invisible to them, and nothing can be matched to you.
dashboard.matchingAssetsHint: Ranked by how well each fits your stated categories, jurisdictions, licences and ticket size.
dashboard.noMatchesHint: Widen your mandate, or check back — new listings arrive regularly.
dashboard.managerHowBody: Suspending a participant hides their listings from the public catalogue without changing the listings themselves, so unsuspending restores exactly what was there before. Removing is a soft delete: the record stays, the pages explain what happened, and every action is written to the audit log with its reason.

match.explainUnavailable: The explanation is unavailable right now. The scoring above is unaffected.

mandateForm.subtitle: This is what sellers search, and what listings are matched against.
mandateForm.thesisHint: Sellers read this before they contact you. Be specific about the outcome you want.
mandateForm.thesisPlaceholder: Acquiring an EU e-money institution with live IBAN issuing to launch a business banking product.
mandateForm.emptyMeansAny: Leave everything unticked to mean no preference.
mandateForm.needsActive: I need an operating business, not a licence on its own
mandateForm.visibilityHint: Hidden keeps you out of the seller catalogue entirely. You can still browse and start conversations.
mandateForm.aboutHint: Optional. Background that helps a seller decide whether to engage.

moderation.noParticipantsHint: Clear the search or change the role and status filters.
moderation.noAssetsHint: Clear the search or pick a different status.
moderation.noEventsHint: Suspending or removing a participant or a listing writes a row here.
